title: Discovery of organosulfur-based selective HDAC8 inhibitors with anti-neuroblastoma activity.
authors: Cho, Hyewon; Lee, Eun; Kim, Jisoo; Shin, Soojeong; Kim, Yoon-Jung; Lee, Heejin; Yu, Ji Hoon; Jeon, Yong Hyun; Lee, Sang Wu; Lee, So Young; Park, Ki Whan; Kang, Jong Soon; Kwon, So Hee; Kim, Yonjung; Jeon, Raok
journal: European journal of pharmaceutical sciences : official journal of the European Federation for Pharmaceutical Sciences
one_liner_zh: 该文研究有机硫类HDAC8抑制剂的设计与抗神经母细胞瘤活性，属于药物化学与酶抑制领域，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: Histone deacetylases (HDACs) are important epigenetic regulators of gene expression and various cellular processes, and are potential targets for anticancer therapy. In particular, HDAC8 is a promising therapeutic target for childhood neuroblastoma. To date, five HDAC inhibitors have been approved as anticancer drugs; however, all are non-selective HDAC inhibitors with various side effects. Furthermore, many promising HDAC inhibitors incorporate hydroxamic acid as a zinc binding group (ZBG), which may be associated with toxicity. Therefore, identification of isoform-selective HDAC inhibitors with novel ZBG is crucial. Here, a series of sulfur-based selective HDAC8 inhibitors featuring a novel ZBG were identified by modifying the early hit, ajoene, a component of garlic. Structure-activity relationship studies uncovered potent and selective HDAC8 inhibitors, and docking studies provided a structural rationale for HDAC8 inhibitory activity. One of the potent compounds, (Z)-1-phenyl-7-(4-methoxyphenyl)-2,3,7-trithiahepta-4-ene-7-oxide (15c), exhibited antiproliferative activity, with a GI(50) of 2 microM, against neuroblastoma cell lines. 15c also showed significant in vivo efficacy in a neuroblastoma BE(2)-C xenograft model.
abstract_zh: 组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDACs）是基因表达及多种细胞过程的重要表观遗传调控因子，并是抗癌治疗的潜在靶点。特别是，HDAC8是儿童神经母细胞瘤的一个有前景的治疗靶点。迄今为止，已有五种HDAC抑制剂被批准作为抗癌药物；然而，它们均为非选择性HDAC抑制剂，并伴有多种副作用。此外，许多有前景的HDAC抑制剂将异羟肟酸作为锌结合基团（ZBG），这可能与毒性相关。因此，识别具有新型ZBG的亚型选择性HDAC抑制剂至关重要。在此，通过修饰早期命中化合物大蒜素（ajoene，大蒜的一种成分），鉴定了一系列以新型ZBG为特征、基于硫的选择性HDAC8抑制剂。构效关系研究揭示了强效且选择性的HDAC8抑制剂，而对接研究为HDAC8抑制活性提供了结构基础。其中一种强效化合物（Z）-1-苯基-7-（4-甲氧基苯基）-2,3,7-三硫杂庚-4-烯-7-氧化物（15c）对神经母细胞瘤细胞系表现出抗增殖活性，其GI(50)为2微摩尔。15c在神经母细胞瘤BE(2)-C异种移植模型中还显示出显著的体内疗效。
